ranking_definition.mass_definition: sum of answer-query attention over every token in each active needle span
ranking_definition.ordering: descending score with the discovery registry order frozen before confirmation

selection_rule.frozen_values_source: pre-specified geometric K grid over the hash-locked full-span discovery ranking
selection_rule.no_reselection_rule: neither the registry order nor K grid may change after any seed 1316..1335 outcome is observed
selection_rule.interpretation: a dose-response and saturation audit, not an estimate of a unique number of functional heads

discovery_source.prior_seed_scope_note: 1315 includes the previous seed-extrapolation campaign; this sweep uses the next untouched contiguous suffix

confirmation_design.shared_run_rule: all-example and clean-correct analyses are derived from the same intervention rows
confirmation_design.uncertainty: nonparametric seed-cluster bootstrap 95% CI with 10000 deterministic draws
confirmation_design.companion_test: two-sided seed-cluster sign-flip tests with Holm correction across the twelve frozen model-by-K comparisons for each endpoint
confirmation_design.multiplicity_note: the two models by six doses form twelve frozen comparisons per endpoint
